Subject: Sentinel Freight — POC evaluation plan & week 1 check-in

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook for the 3-week POC: 

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood can reduce per-booking inference cost by >= 40% while maintaining >= 98% routing-label accuracy on your end-to-end telemetry.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: median tail < 300ms for 95% of inference calls under a 10rps simulated load.
- Accuracy: match your current label baseline within +/-2 percentage points on the holdout set.
- Cost: per inference token cost reduction target >= 40% vs your current endpoint.

Owner breakdown (proposed):
- Sentinel technical lead: Sarah Park (integration / SSO / dataset access)
- Redwood infra & harness: Marcus Lin (test harness, load sim)
- Redwood prompts & evals: Priyom Das (prompt templates, scoring)
- Security/compliance questions: Neha Kapoor (SOC2 / data controls)

Immediate next actions (this week):
1) Sentinel: share the evaluation sample + any labels (Tom / Sarah). (target: today)
2) Redwood: provision dev endpoint + send invite to sandbox Drive (Marcus). (target: 7/27)
3) Schedule 30m kickoff to align on metrics and schedule (Ava to propose times). (target: by 7/27)

Attachments: sentinel_eval_sample.csv (subset of telemetry, anonymized)

If the success criteria above look right, please reply with a confirmation and any edits. Once confirmed we'll lock the SOW and calendar invites.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

---

Subject: Re: Sentinel Freight — POC evaluation plan & week 1 check-in

Ava — thanks for the summary. Confirming the proposed success criteria look good to us with two clarifications: 

- Accuracy baseline: we will send the labeled holdout (10k rows) — please run your scoring on that exact set; we’ll accept +/-2pp.
- Privacy: the sample attached today is pseudonymized, but we will need confirmation on how Redwood handles ephemeral KV cache and whether logs are retained by default during the POC. If you can confirm retention defaults (and whether we can opt out), that would help.

Assigning leads: Sarah will be our tech lead and will upload the full telemetry sample to the Drive link you provide. I’m looping in IT Procurement (procure@sentinelfreight.com) for the SOW review once you send it.

Attachment: current-telemetry-sample.csv

Thanks — Tom
Head of Data Science | Sentinel Freight
